item.title: BGSU Firelands to celebrate 60 years of impact

item.title: Guardians pound out 16 hits, three home runs in 12-3 rout of White Sox
item.description: C.J Kayfus, Milan Tolentino and Carter Kieboom each hit home runs, and the Guardians dominated the White Sox, 12-3, in a Cactus League game on March 5. Cleveland finished with 16 hits. Jaison Chourio tripled, and Angel Martinez, Brayan Rocchio, George Valera and Angel Genao each doubled. Martinez, Austin Hedges and Kody Huff each had two hits.
